name: Inland Empire Comfort

navy.role: HERO — headline backgrounds, CTA text, primary fills, logo, strokes. Dominant brand color on every post.

light_blue.role: Soft secondary backgrounds, info cards, list-item backgrounds. Cool half of palette.

red.role: DEFAULT ACCENT — stars, numerals in lists, CTA buttons, urgency pills, ribbons, quote marks.

teal.role: RESTRICTED accent only — tiny dots/underlines/icons. Never a fill, never a background.

gold.role: RESTRICTED — rare highlight bars only. Not the default accent.

cream.role: Warm off-white background for light-mode cards

white.role: Clean backgrounds, white text on navy

typography.body: Poppins / Source Sans Pro (clean, friendly sans)
typography.italic_accent: Lora / Cormorant for emphasis words in headlines

phone_numbers._format_rule: DOTS ONLY (no parens, no dashes). This is the social-media attribution line. MUST appear on every IEC social image AND in every IEC caption footer.
phone_numbers._main_use: Website CTAs and non-social copy ONLY. NEVER burned into a social media image.

archetypes.IEC_A_photo_curved_divider: Photo on right with signature S-curve left edge sweeping into cream/text panel on left. Headline + body + CTA. The IEC signature look.
archetypes.IEC_B_navy_hero_with_photo_below: Navy panel top with red ribbon eyebrow + serif/italic headline + white pill CTA. Photo of home or AC unit bottom half.
archetypes.IEC_C_full_photo_overlay: Full-bleed dramatic photo (technician at night, family with AC) with bottom dark overlay carrying ribbon + headline + CTA pill.
archetypes.IEC_D_review_card: Solid navy background. Big red opening quote. Italic serif customer quote. 5 red filled stars. Light-blue customer attribution pill. CTA pill.
archetypes.IEC_E_listicle_cards: Cream background. Red ribbon header. Bold all-caps Oswald headline (with red box around emphasized word). 3+ stacked alternating cards (navy, cream, light-blue) with numbered items. Red CTA pill.
archetypes.IEC_F_seasonal_promo: Photo top + light-blue panel bottom with red ribbon eyebrow + serif italic mixed headline + CTA pill.

hard_rules: Phone burned into image MUST be 951.789.3238 (social-tracking line, dots format).
NEVER burn (951) 482-7457 into a social image. That's website-only.
Caption MUST end with the footer block: #InlandEmpireComfort / License No.: 1053697 / 📞: 951.789.3238
Navy #19437B is the hero color — every post leans on it.
Yellow #F7CF21 and Teal #68CCD1 are RESTRICTED — rare highlights only.
IEC client adds the IEC logo MANUALLY to images — DO NOT use overlay_logo.py for IEC. Leave a clean top zone.
Photo treatment when applicable: signature S-curve divider on the left edge of the photo column.

TECHNICIAN UNIFORM (STRICT): IEC techs wear a SOLID NAVY short-sleeve POLO + dark navy work pants, with the circular IEC emblem on the BACK. ALWAYS shown from BEHIND or side profile, kneeling and actively working on a furnace or AC condenser (back to camera, face not visible). NEVER a light-blue/gray/white shirt, NEVER a collared button-up, NEVER any hat or cap, NEVER a front chest patch or text on clothing, NEVER front-facing or posed, NEVER a group/team lineup. Reference photos: photos/tech_back_logo_*.
Reels/videos/stories do NOT get a static design — the video is the deliverable.

FULL-BLEED (STRICT): the design fills the entire canvas edge-to-edge. No outer margin/padding, no border or frame, no rounded outer corners, no drop shadow, no device/mockup frame, never a card floating on a separate background. The image IS the design, not a picture of a design.
